caption: Our test subscriber showed up in the list about 30 seconds after MailerLite said Saved. Adding one subscriber to a new group took under a minute. Both addresses are hidden.

Until you connect a domain, campaigns go out from a temporary sender address, and MailerLite says your own domain delivers better. Our one test email still reached the inbox, not spam. The sender address is hidden.
The send step offers send now, send later, by timezone or smart sending. We did not send this campaign. The sender address is hidden.
On 22 November Plan and Billing showed Free, up to 250 subscribers and 2,500 emails, while the header said 14-day trial. The account name and email are hidden.
The upgrade screen lists only Comfort at $12 and Power at $25 a month for 500 subscribers. At checkout, Comfort monthly wanted the full amount at once, even with 14 trial days left.
